name: lingshu
title: Lingshu
summary: An open medical vision-language model: describes what a few slices of the image show.
description: Lingshu-7B, served by vLLM on the platform's own GPU: the slices leave for no third party. It takes a few minutes to start, so it suits several questions in a row more than one.
author: Alibaba DAMO Academy (Lingshu), imagin4care (agent)

purpose.detail: A description of rendered slices of a medical image, in plain words.

legal.intendedUse: A general description of an image for teaching and research. Research use only, not a medical device, not a diagnosis.
legal.limitations: Sees a few rendered slices, not the volume. Can be wrong with confidence. Not evaluated here on any task.
